== Notes ==
* The recipe used to acquire this item requires materials that are restricted to the [[Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns|Heart of Thorns]] expansion. However, the recipe is unlocked automatically for players without the expansion.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Fulgurite|Fulgurites]] form when lightning strikes the ground, melting sand and soil into glassy tubes (by coincidence, one of the ingredients for the fulgurites in the game, obsidian, is also a type of mineral glass — although formed by very different processes).
